title: Certificate-Coupled DCA for the Trust-Region Subproblem: Early Structural Escape and Progressive Global Certification
summary: We study the nonconvex trust-region subproblem by a certificate-coupled difference-of-convex algorithm that incorporates spectral information before exact first-order stationarity is attained. The method maintains a persistent randomized Krylov subspace together with the DCA iterates. Near stationarity, a sufficiently negative shifted Rayleigh quotient yields an explicit feasible correction with a quantitative decrease in the objective value; otherwise, completion of a prescribed Lanczos depth provides, with high probability, an approximate positive-semidefiniteness certificate.
